description: Fetch a Jira issue as a developer brief: description, acceptance criteria, comments and attachments. Use depth "full" for parent/epic/linked-issue context and includeConfluence for related documentation. Use this to read a ticket. To start work, check readiness, verify changes or write a report, call jira_prepare_work_brief or the delivery_* tool directly: they fetch the issue themselves.

depth.description: basic = the issue only; full = also parent, epic, linked issues, subtasks and comments

includeConfluence.description: Also search Confluence for related pages and fold them into the result (implies full depth)

name: jira_get_issue
title: Get a Jira issue
